combatText.title: Dacatarai Stance
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D]. *newpara* If your opponent has more unrouted units than you, gain 2 (S).
combatText.unit: Custodian/Cruiser: During this execution round, if your opponent has to assign any damage, he assigns 2 additional damage.

combatText.title: Rendax Stance
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [D] or 1 [M]. *newpara* If your opponent has at least 1 unrouted unit that is not a command level 0 unit, gain 1 (B) and 1 (S).
combatText.unit: Custodian/Cruiser: At the start of the assess damage step of this execution round, if you have 1 [B] or 1 (B), force your opponent to choose and rout 1 of his units.

combatText.title: Fight Through Fire
combatText.general: Your opponent chooses and routs 1 of his units.
combatText.unit: Custodian/Cruiser: At the start of the next execution round you may choose to convert 1 of your [B] into [S] to gain 2 (B).

combatText.title: Stand Your Ground
combatText.unit: Custodian: Spend 1 [M] to choose 1 of your units, during this execution round that unit cannot become routed or retreat.

combatText.title: Undying Conviction
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D]. *newpara* If your opponent has more unrouted units than you, gain 1 (B), 1 (S), or 1 [M].
combatText.unit: Custodian/Champion/Cruiser: Gain either 1 (B) or 1 (S). *newpara* Spend 1 [M] to choose 1 of your units, during this execution round, that unit cannot be destroyed by abilities on cards.

combatText.title: Brave Charge
combatText.unit: Champion: Gain 1 (B) for each of your opponent's unrouted units in excess of your unrouted units.

combatText.title: Inspiring Leader
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [D] or 1 [M]. *newpara* Either gain 1 [M] or rally 1 of your units.
combatText.unit: Champion/Cruiser: Convert up to 2 of your [M] into either [B] or [S].

combatText.title: Purge the Weak
combatText.general: For each of your opponent's unrouted command level 0 units and for each of his routed units, gain 1 (B) up to a maximum of 3.
combatText.unit: Champion/Cruiser: During this execution round, the first time an enemy unit is routed it is destroyed, unless your opponent chooses and routs 1 of his units.

combatText.title: Defend Our Honour
combatText.general: Choose 1 of your units and gain its morale value as either (B) or (S).
combatText.unit: Champion/Cruiser: Choose either a Blade Champion or a Classified Cruiser, during this execution round that unit cannot become routed.

combatText.title: The Golden Death
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D]. *newpara* Spend 1 [B] to gain 3 (B). Your opponent may spend 1 [M] to retreat 1 of his units.
combatText.unit: Galatus Dreadnought: Choose and rout 1 of your command level 3 units to gain 3 (B).

combatText.title: Heroic Stand
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [D] or 1 (S). *newpara* Gain 1 [D] unless your opponent retreats 1 of his units.
combatText.unit: Galatus Dreadnought/Moiraideis: During this execution round, your command level 3 units cannot be routed, and all of your units cannot be destroyed by abilities on cards.

combatText.title: Moved by Honour
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D]. *newpara* Gain either 1 (B) or 1 (S). *newpara* Rally 1 of your units.
combatText.unit: Galatus Dreadnought/Moiraideis: Retreat 1 of your units, if you do, gain 2 (B) and rally that unit.

combatText.title: Praise to the Emperor!
combatText.unit: Valoris: During this combat you have a dice limit of 12 dice. *newpara* Gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: The Emperor's Spear
combatText.general: Rally 1 of your units. Draw a combat card.
combatText.unit: Valoris: Retreat all of your units that are not Trajann Valoris to play any combat card from your hand that is not The Emperor's Spear.

ordersText.title: Emperor's Will
ordersText.general: When you reveal this order token, starting in round 2, treat all uncontrolled worlds that do not contain your objective token as friendly worlds for the remainder of the game. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER GAME.

ordersText.title: The Auric Advance
ordersText.general: When you reveal this order token, you may resolve it as if it were an Advance Order instead. During this Advance Order you may only move up to 2 of your units. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Blessing of the Emperor
ordersText.general: When you reveal this order token, you may rally 1 of your units in either this system or any adjacent system. That unit may not be moved while resolving this order. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Solar Vanguard
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, if you purchased a unit, you may move 1 of your purchased units to a friendly area that contains your units or structures in an adjacent system. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Step of Judgement
ordersText.general: After you resolve this order, you may choose 1 of your units in this system and rally it. You may then move that unit to an adjacent area. This can start a combat. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: The Throne's Call
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, at the start of an assess damage step of combat, you may retreat 1 of your units and then rally that unit. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: The Inner Palace
eventsText.general: Either gain 1 materiel or take 1 friendly unit from any world and place it on a friendly world with a city.

eventsText.title: Lex Ultima
eventsText.general: Resolve a deploy order in 1 system containing any of your factories.

eventsText.title: Guardians of Humanity
eventsText.general: Purchase a command level 2 order upgrade even if your command level is lower, reducing its materiel cost by 1 for each friendly world providing a prosperity token.

eventsText.title: Emperor's Protection
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the end of a reinforce step of combat, you may discard this card to gain 1 (S) at the start of each execution round during this combat.

eventsText.title: The Golden Rule
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the end of a reinforce step of combat, you may discard this card to gain 1 (B) at the start of each execution round during this combat.

eventsText.title: Eyes of the Emperor
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* When 1 of your units is destroyed or retreats during combat, you may discard this card to take it and place it back routed in this area. Gain 2 (S).

eventsText.title: The Ten Thousand
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the start of an execution round of combat, you may discard this card to draw 2 combat cards.

abilities.title: The Guided Path
abilities.text: When you resolve a dominate order, you may place 1 of your order tokens from your play area onto the top of your event deck.

abilities.title: The Ten Thousand
abilities.text: Passive ability. During a reinforcement step of combat, gain 1 [D] for each reinforcement token you placed and then discard the tokens.
